record.paper_title: Some open problems on the analysis of the Cauchy-Fueter system in several variables
record.original_question: Given a hypercomplex algebra, study all possible families of operators that linearize the wave operator. This problem sits in the setting of hypercomplex operators that linearize ultrahyperbolic or wave-type operators, including operators related to Maxwell's system for biquaternion-valued functions and operators linearizing the Klein-Gordon equation using octonions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ be a hypercomplex algebra, i.e., a finite-dimensional unital real algebra equipped with a basis $\{e_0=1,e_1,\dots,e_{n}\}$ satisfying prescribed multiplication relations (examples include the quaternions $\mathbb{H}$, the biquaternions $\mathbb{H}\otimes\mathbb{C}$, and the octonions $\mathbb{O}$). For functions $f:\mathbb{R}^{p,q}	o A$ on a (possibly indefinite) real space, consider first-order linear differential operators of the form
$$D=\sum_{j=0}^{m} a_j\,\partial_{x_j},\qquad a_j\in A,$$
or more generally finite families $(D_1,\dots,D_r)$ of such operators with coefficients in $A$. Say that such a family linearizes the wave operator $\square=\partial_{x_0}^2-\partial_{x_1}^2-\cdots-\partial_{x_m}^2$ (or, more generally, an ultrahyperbolic operator of signature $(p,q)$) if there exist operators $D_1',\dots,D_r'$ of the same form such that
$$D_i' D_j + D_j' D_i = 2\delta_{ij}\,\square\quad	ext{for all }i,j,$$
so that composing the family with its companion family reproduces the wave (or ultrahyperbolic) operator on each component.

Problem: For an arbitrary hypercomplex algebra $A$, classify all families of first-order $A$-linear differential operators that linearize the wave operator (and, more generally, ultrahyperbolic operators). In particular, describe completely the cases corresponding to (i) operators related to Maxwell's system acting on biquaternion-valued functions and (ii) operators linearizing the Klein–Gordon equation by means of octonions.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open research direction in the context of hypercomplex analysis (Cauchy–Fueter type systems). While various individual linearizations of the wave/Klein–Gordon/Maxwell operators by quaternionic, biquaternionic, Clifford, and octonionic operators are known in the literature, a complete classification for an arbitrary hypercomplex algebra does not appear to have been achieved. No definitive resolution was found.
